{{Quote|The planet Wynkahthu.|Hondo Ohnaka|<ref name="The Wynkahthu Job" />}}
'''Wynkahthu''' was a [[gas giant]]<ref name="Wynkahthu" /> in the [[Mid Rim Territories]]<ref name="Timelines" /> with turbulent [[Atmosphere|atmospheric]] storms located near [[Ord Mantell]].<ref name="Wynkahthu" /> In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="The Wynkahthu Job date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> the rebel group known as the [[Spectres]] [[Mission to loot an Imperial cargo ship|journeyed]] to Wynkahthu with the [[pirate]] [[captain]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]] and the gangster [[Azmorigan]] to secure the contents of an adrift [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Class four container transport|cargo ship]]. Their ship, the ''[[Ghost]]'', remained outside of the atmospheric storm that had trapped the Imperial ship while [[Ezra Bridger]], [[Garazeb Orrelios|Zeb Orrelios]], Ohnaka, and Azmorigan entered the ship to locate the precious cargo onboard.<ref name="The Wynkahthu Job" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Wynkahthu first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode "[[The Wynkahthu Job]]," the ninth episode of the show's [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]].<ref name="The Wynkahthu Job" />
